messages:
sasha: quick async preflight — slice 3 -> 7 canary goes live in ~30m. doing a brief what-I-did / blockers / today: set up warmup cache + deployment, expecting KV eviction noise. ping if you see error spikes.

kevin: thanks. quick note — observability dashboard has new charts: token-latency by slice and kv-hit-rate. look at /dash/rollout/slice7.

maria: rolled the FF toggle to staging, ran smoke tests for prompt-responses. saw 0.2% increase in 5xx on a small subset (mostly long-context). investigating.

aj: blocker: staging showed a rare OOM on gpu-node-12 when seq_len > 4096. I added a soft limit for that slice and a fallback to smaller chunking. cc @sasha for rollout policy.

sasha: noted. aj, can you paste the fallback command you used? we might need it in the runbook.

aj: sure — copying snippet:
```bash
# fallback: enable micro-chunking for long requests
redwoodctl config set --slice=7 --opt chunking.micro=true --opt chunking.size=2048
redwoodctl rollout apply --slice=7 --target nodeset=gpu-pool-b
```

rana: ops-bot ran a quick capacity check — we have ~12% spare on eu-west and ~6% spare in us-central. if traffic holds, consider temporary warmup in eu-west.

ops-bot: [auto] capacity-check: eu-west spare=12%, us-central spare=6%, us-east spare=2%. alert if any region < 5%.

kevin: suggestion — we do a safety ramp: 5% -> 15% -> 50% over 40m with 10m holds and automatic rollback on error-rate > 0.5%. I can set the rollout policy.

sasha: do it. please also add a canary-specific tracing tag so we can slice traces by ff=onion-lift=true.

kevin: will add. rollout plan applied: 5% now. hold 10m then 15%. watchers: @maria @aj @sasha.

maria: watching logs. adding a small eval set to measure generation quality drift. will post results in 10m.

aj: monitoring infra. if OOMs spike, I'll flip micro-chunking to on for slice 7 automatically.

rana: alerting note — I set a transient alert: 
- error-rate > 0.4% for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall + pager
- kv-hit-rate drop > 20% for 10m -> notify @kevin + #eng-platform

sasha: thanks team. if no major regressions after 20m, we'll continue to 50%. update here with any anomalies. :rocket:
